claim: Co-detection of both colours at the reported aggregate-section scale can coexist with strong among-section colour-frequency differentiation.
hard_limits: Established published example, not a new ecological discovery or independent biological replicate.
Four sections within one focal area, not 28 independent populations or 100500 independent study replicates.
Original approx 2m subplot data and independent genet identifiers were not recovered.
H_between/H_total is descriptive photographic-independent phenotype diversity allocation, not genetic F_ST or causal fitness variance.
No-plants year has missing colour frequency, not monomorphism, loss of polymorphism or proven extinction.
Hesperis summaries cannot be turned into invented per-stand counts or trajectories.
Do not combine these differently sampled spatial units into a multi-species test.
